Kermode bears are not more related to the blonde brown bears of Alaska's ABC Islands than other members of the American black bear species. The double recessive gene causing the white or cream colour is unique to the Kermode bear subspecies. The white or cream colour of the Kermode bear is due to a double recessive gene.
